description: Outputs generated by a successfully provisioned Container.

name.description: Container name in the managed container backend

publicEndpoints.description: Public endpoints resolved for this container.

oneOf.description: Load balancer endpoint information for DNS management.

dnsName.description: The DNS name of the load balancer endpoint (e.g., ALB DNS, API Gateway domain).

hostedZoneId.description: AWS Route53 hosted zone ID (for ALIAS records). Only set on AWS.

wildcardHost.description: Wildcard hostname routed to this endpoint, when configured.

items.description: Status of a single container replica.

machineId.description: Machine ID the replica is running on

oneOf.description: Whether the persistent volumes' snapshot schedule is in place.

message.description: What is missing when the state is `setupRequired`

items.description: A replica's persistent volume and its latest completed snapshot.

oneOf.description: The latest volume restore performed on this ordinal, if any

completedAt.description: When the restored volume was put in place (RFC 3339)

replacedVolumeSnapshotId.description: Snapshot of the replaced volume, taken just before it was deleted

snapshotId.description: Snapshot the volume was restored from

lastSnapshotAt.description: When the latest completed snapshot was started (RFC 3339)

lastSnapshotId.description: Cloud ID of the latest completed snapshot, if any

ordinal.description: Replica ordinal the volume belongs to

volumeId.description: Cloud ID of the volume (EBS volume ID, Persistent Disk name, or Managed Disk ID)

volumes.description: Persistent volumes, one per replica ordinal, with their latest snapshot.
